mapper.sql: id, purchase_no AS purchaseNo, title, requester_id AS requesterId, requester_name AS requesterName, buyer_id AS buyerId, buyer_name AS buyerName, project_id AS projectId, project_name AS projectName, funding_source AS fundingSource, supplier_name AS supplierName, platform_type AS platformType, platform_order_no AS platformOrderNo, currency, item_subtotal AS itemSubtotal, shipping_amount AS shippingAmount, discount_amount AS discountAmount, payable_amount AS payableAmount, actual_paid_amount AS actualPaidAmount, payment_difference_note AS paymentDifferenceNote, status, approval_required AS approvalRequired, approval_policy_version AS approvalPolicyVersion, approval_reasons_json AS approvalReasonsJson, approval_trigger_snapshot_json AS approvalTriggerSnapshotJson, ordered_at AS orderedAt, completed_at AS completedAt, close_reason AS closeReason, version, created_by AS createdBy, create_time AS createTime, updated_by AS updatedBy, update_time AS updateTime

o.id, o.purchase_no AS purchaseNo, o.title, o.requester_id AS requesterId, o.requester_name AS requesterName, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, o.buyer_name AS buyerName, o.project_id AS projectId, o.project_name AS projectName, o.funding_source AS fundingSource, o.supplier_name AS supplierName, o.platform_type AS platformType, o.platform_order_no AS platformOrderNo, o.currency, o.item_subtotal AS itemSubtotal, o.shipping_amount AS shippingAmount, o.discount_amount AS discountAmount, o.payable_amount AS payableAmount, o.actual_paid_amount AS actualPaidAmount, o.payment_difference_note AS paymentDifferenceNote, o.status, o.approval_required AS approvalRequired, o.approval_policy_version AS approvalPolicyVersion, o.approval_reasons_json AS approvalReasonsJson, o.ordered_at AS orderedAt, o.completed_at AS completedAt, o.close_reason AS closeReason, o.version, o.create_time AS createTime, o.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_procurement_order( purchase_no, title, requester_id, requester_name, project_id, project_name, funding_source, currency, item_subtotal, shipping_amount, discount_amount, payable_amount, status, version, created_by, create_time, updated_by, update_time ) VALUES( #{purchaseNo}, #{title}, #{requesterId}, #{requesterName}, #{projectId}, #{projectName}, #{fundingSource}, 'CNY', #{itemSubtotal}, #{shippingAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{payableAmount}, 'DRAFT', 1, #{createdBy}, #{createTime}, #{updatedBy}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE lab_procurement_order SET title=#{title}, project_id=#{projectId}, project_name=#{projectName}, funding_source=#{fundingSource}, item_subtotal=#{itemSubtotal}, shipping_amount=#{shippingAmount}, discount_amount=#{discountAmount}, payable_amount=#{payableAmount}, version=version+1, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, update_time=#{updateTime} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='DRAFT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_procurement_order_line( order_id, line_no, component_id, component_name, manufacturer_name, mpn, component_spec_snapshot_id, spec_version, unit, ordered_quantity, unit_price, line_subtotal, received_quantity, canceled_quantity, version ) VALUES( #{orderId}, #{lineNo}, #{component.id}, #{component.name}, #{component.manufacturerName}, #{component.mpn}, #{component.currentSpecSnapshotId}, #{component.specVersion}, #{component.baseUnit}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{lineSubtotal}, 0.000, 0.000, 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM lab_procurement_order WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT FROM lab_procurement_order WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM lab_procurement_order o WHERE o.id=#{id}

SELECT id, line_no AS lineNo, component_id AS componentId, component_name AS componentName, manufacturer_name AS manufacturerName, mpn, component_spec_snapshot_id AS componentSpecSnapshotId, spec_version AS specVersion, unit, ordered_quantity AS orderedQuantity, unit_price AS unitPrice, line_subtotal AS lineSubtotal, allocated_net_amount AS allocatedNetAmount, effective_unit_cost AS effectiveUnitCost, received_quantity AS receivedQuantity, canceled_quantity AS canceledQuantity, (ordered_quantity-received_quantity-canceled_quantity) AS remainingQuantity, version FROM lab_procurement_order_line WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY line_no ASC, id ASC

SELECT a.id,a.decision,a.policy_version AS policyVersion,a.actor_type AS actorType, a.decided_by AS decidedBy,u.username AS decidedByName,a.decided_at AS decidedAt,a.comment FROM lab_procurement_approval_record a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=a.decided_by WHERE a.order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY a.decided_at ASC,a.id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.name, m.name AS manufacturerName, c.mpn, c.base_unit AS baseUnit, c.status, c.current_spec_snapshot_id AS currentSpecSnapshotId, c.spec_version AS specVersion FROM lab_component c INNER JOIN lab_component_manufacturer m ON m.id=c.manufacturer_id WHERE c.id=#{id}

SELECT l.id, l.component_id AS componentId, c.name AS componentName, m.name AS manufacturerName, c.mpn, c.status AS componentStatus, c.current_spec_snapshot_id AS currentSpecSnapshotId, c.spec_version AS specVersion, c.category_id AS categoryId, cat.path AS categoryPath, l.unit_price AS unitPrice, l.ordered_quantity AS orderedQuantity, l.line_subtotal AS lineSubtotal FROM lab_procurement_order_line l INNER JOIN lab_component c ON c.id=l.component_id INNER JOIN lab_component_manufacturer m ON m.id=c.manufacturer_id INNER JOIN lab_component_category cat ON cat.id=c.category_id WHERE l.order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY l.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE lab_procurement_order_line SET component_name=#{componentName}, manufacturer_name=#{manufacturerName}, mpn=#{mpn}, component_spec_snapshot_id=#{currentSpecSnapshotId}, spec_version=#{specVersion}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT FROM lab_procurement_policy_version ORDER BY policy_version DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM lab_procurement_policy_version ORDER BY policy_version DESC
SELECT category_id FROM lab_procurement_policy_forced_category WHERE policy_id=#{policyId} ORDER BY category_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE lab_procurement_order SET status=#{status}, approval_required=#{approvalRequired}, approval_policy_version=#{policyVersion}, approval_reasons_json=#{reasonsJson}, approval_trigger_snapshot_json=#{triggerSnapshotJson}, version=version+1, updated_by=#{actorId}, update_time=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT decided_by FROM lab_procurement_approval_record WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND decision='APPROVED' AND actor_type='USER' ORDER BY decided_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE lab_procurement_order SET status='ORDERED', buyer_id=#{buyerId}, buyer_name=#{buyerName}, supplier_name=#{supplierName}, platform_type=#{platformType}, platform_order_no=#{platformOrderNo}, normalized_platform_order_no=#{normalizedPlatformOrderNo}, actual_paid_amount=#{actualPaidAmount}, payment_difference_note=#{paymentDifferenceNote}, ordered_at=#{now}, version=version+1, updated_by=#{actorId}, update_time=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='APPROVED'
UPDATE lab_procurement_order_line SET allocated_net_amount=#{allocatedNetAmount}, effective_unit_cost=#{effectiveUnitCost}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE lab_procurement_order_line SET canceled_quantity=ordered_quantity-received_quantity, version=version+1 WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND ordered_quantity-received_quantity-canceled_quantity > 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_procurement_receipt WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND status='CONFIRMED'
mapper.sql: id,receipt_no AS receiptNo,order_id AS orderId,status,received_at AS receivedAt, receiver_id AS receiverId,receiver_name AS receiverName,note, confirmed_at AS confirmedAt,canceled_at AS canceledAt,version, created_by AS createdBy,create_time AS createTime,updated_by AS updatedBy,update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM lab_procurement_receipt WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT FROM lab_procurement_receipt WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id,r.receipt_no AS receiptNo,r.order_id AS orderId,o.purchase_no AS purchaseNo, r.status,r.received_at AS receivedAt,r.receiver_id AS receiverId, r.receiver_name AS receiverName,r.note,r.confirmed_at AS confirmedAt, r.canceled_at AS canceledAt,r.version,o.version AS orderVersion, r.create_time AS createTime,r.update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_procurement_receipt r INNER JOIN lab_procurement_order o ON o.id=r.order_id WHERE r.id=#{id}

SELECT rl.id,rl.order_line_id AS orderLineId,rl.component_id AS componentId, ol.component_name AS componentName,rl.quantity,rl.unit, rl.supplier_lot_no AS supplierLotNo,rl.production_date AS productionDate, rl.expiry_date AS expiryDate,rl.location_note AS locationNote, rl.quality_note AS qualityNote,rl.version FROM lab_procurement_receipt_line rl INNER JOIN lab_procurement_order_line ol ON ol.id=rl.order_line_id WHERE rl.receipt_id=#{receiptId} ORDER BY rl.id ASC
mapper.sql: id,receipt_id AS receiptId,order_line_id AS orderLineId,component_id AS componentId, quantity,unit,supplier_lot_no AS supplierLotNo,production_date AS productionDate, expiry_date AS expiryDate,location_note AS locationNote,quality_note AS qualityNote,version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM lab_procurement_receipt_line WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT FROM lab_procurement_receipt_line WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId} ORDER BY id ASC FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id,r.receipt_no AS receiptNo,r.order_id AS orderId,o.purchase_no AS purchaseNo, r.status,r.received_at AS receivedAt,r.receiver_id AS receiverId, r.receiver_name AS receiverName,r.note,r.confirmed_at AS confirmedAt, r.canceled_at AS canceledAt,r.version,o.version AS orderVersion, r.create_time AS createTime,r.update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_procurement_receipt r INNER JOIN lab_procurement_order o ON o.id=r.order_id WHERE r.order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC,r.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE lab_procurement_receipt SET received_at=#{receivedAt},note=#{note},version=version+1, updated_by=#{actorId},update_time=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='DRAFT'

UPDATE lab_procurement_receipt SET status='CANCELED',active_draft_slot=NULL,canceled_at=#{now}, version=version+1,updated_by=#{actorId},update_time=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT id,line_no AS lineNo,component_id AS componentId,component_name AS componentName, manufacturer_name AS manufacturerName,mpn, component_spec_snapshot_id AS componentSpecSnapshotId,spec_version AS specVersion, unit,ordered_quantity AS orderedQuantity,unit_price AS unitPrice,line_subtotal AS lineSubtotal, allocated_net_amount AS allocatedNetAmount,effective_unit_cost AS effectiveUnitCost, received_quantity AS receivedQuantity,canceled_quantity AS canceledQuantity, (ordered_quantity-received_quantity-canceled_quantity) AS remainingQuantity,version FROM lab_procurement_order_line WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND id IN #{id} ORDER BY id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_component_inventory_balance(component_id,on_hand_quantity,unit,version,update_time) VALUES(#{componentId},0.000,#{unit},1,#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE component_id=component_id
mapper.select: SELECT component_id AS componentId,on_hand_quantity AS onHandQuantity,unit,version,update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_component_inventory_balance WHERE component_id IN #{id} ORDER BY component_id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE lab_procurement_order_line SET received_quantity=received_quantity+#{quantity},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND received_quantity+canceled_quantity+#{quantity} <= ordered_quantity
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_procurement_order_line WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND ordered_quantity-received_quantity-canceled_quantity > 0
mapper.update: UPDATE lab_procurement_receipt SET status='CONFIRMED',active_draft_slot=NULL,receiver_id=#{receiverId},receiver_name=#{receiverName}, confirmed_at=#{now},version=version+1,updated_by=#{receiverId},update_time=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS componentId,c.name AS componentName,c.status, COALESCE(b.on_hand_quantity,0.000) AS onHandQuantity,c.base_unit AS unit, COALESCE(b.version,0) AS version,b.update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_component c LEFT JOIN lab_component_inventory_balance b ON b.component_id=c.id WHERE c.id=#{componentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_inventory_batch WHERE component_id=#{componentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_inventory_movement WHERE component_id=#{componentId}

SELECT id,movement_no AS movementNo,movement_type AS movementType,component_id AS componentId, batch_id AS batchId,source_id AS sourceId,quantity_delta AS quantityDelta, balance_before AS balanceBefore,balance_after AS balanceAfter,unit,unit_cost AS unitCost, operator_id AS operatorId,occurred_at AS occurredAt FROM lab_inventory_movement WHERE component_id=#{componentId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
